page.overview:
What is Klosmiebhyx?

Klosmiebhyx is a fictional entity created by Kevin L. O'Brien for his short story "October Surprise".

Klosmiebhyx is the daughter of Cxaxukluth and sister of Zstylzhemghi, Ghizguth and Hzioulquoigmnzhah. Born in a black star in the center of a grand nebula, she travelled with Cxaxukluth and most of her relations to Yuggoth. While there, she and Hzioulquoigmnzhah produced Ysbaddaden and Scathach. (: "October Surprise")
